time_index.description: The datetime column that orders the rows. `dsbf.profile(time_index=...)` sets it; without one the check is not applicable.

frequency.description: The spacing of the series, as an offset alias: a count and a unit (`D`, `h`, `min`, `s`, `ms`, `W`: fixed spans; `MS`, `ME`, `QS`, `QE`, `YS`, `YE`: calendar months), such as `15min` or `2W`. Unset, the spacing the profile found in the index is used.

aggregate.description: How the values of one period are combined, which is what repeated timestamps and rows finer than the frequency need.

max_periods.description: Most periods used: the most recent ones. Tests on tens of thousands of points reject trivial deviations, and the cost of the lag regressions grows with them.

max_fill_share.description: Largest share of a series' periods that may be empty and interpolated; a column with more has no series.

value_columns.description: The numeric columns to analyse; empty is every numeric column.

period.description: Periods in one seasonal cycle. Unset, it follows from the frequency: 7 for daily data, 12 for monthly, 4 for quarterly, 24 for hourly.

robust.description: Fit STL robustly, so outliers do not bend the components.

min_cycles.description: Whole cycles of the period a series needs.

min_strength.description: Smallest trend or seasonal strength that is reported: a moderate one. A series with few cycles or periods must also beat what white noise of its length reaches by chance, which is higher.

periods.description: Periods in the series: its length.

periods_filled.description: Empty periods filled by linear interpolation.

rows_used.description: Rows whose value entered the series.

series_start.description: Start of the first period, UTC.

trend_strength.description: 1 - Var(remainder) / Var(trend + remainder), at least 0 (Wang, Smith and Hyndman 2006).

remainder_share.description: Variance of the remainder over the variance of the series.

seasonal_floor.description: The seasonal strength that white noise of this many cycles reaches in 1% of series: a seasonal strength below it is not reported.

trend_floor.description: The same for the trend strength, by number of periods.

index.description: The datetime column that ordered the rows.

frequency.description: The period of every series, as an alias.

aggregate.description: How the values of one period combine.

periods_total.description: Periods the index spans, before the cut to `max_periods`.

timezone.description: Time zone of the index; instants are read as UTC.

skipped.description: Columns with no result, and why.

period.description: The period used for every column; None when none was found.

period_source.description: `configured`, or the frequency it was derived from.

columns.description: Every column that was decomposed, by name. The component series are not kept.
